target_variant: European Portuguese appropriate to Cabo Verde
intent: Supplies the approved English and Portuguese values for the floating Down control's accessible name on the public surfaces that carry no governed in-page section nav (About, Mindelo Essentials, the Things-to-Do hub and Things-to-Do detail pages). Home keeps its existing section-aware Down and does not use this key. The control is injected at runtime by prasa-launch.js and mindelo-essentials.js, so the static-page localizer never sees it; the value reaches the runtime through the governed <script type="application/json" id="i18n-strings"> block. Strictly additive: it introduces no change to any previously approved key and alters no lifecycle, publication, currentness or media policy.

rows.context_notes: Accessible name of the floating Down control on surfaces with no governed in-page section nav. The control pages the viewport downward and stops at the document bottom; it targets no editorial content and depends on no page copy.
rows.linguistic_notes: Project 09 identity policy as supplied: TRANSLATE. Carries no protected brand string and no placeholder.
